All checks passed. Here's a summary of the work done:

**Changes made:**

- **Created** `studio/src/utils/fragment-utils.js` — pure `generateUniqueFragmentTitle(baseTitle, existingTitles)` utility that strips any existing `-N` suffix from the base, then increments a counter until the title is unique.
- **Created** `studio/test/fragment-utils.test.js` — 6 unit tests covering: no conflict, first conflict (`-1`), skipping past existing clones, stripping existing suffix, empty list, and gap-skipping.
- **Edited** `studio/src/mas-repository.js` — imported the new utility; replaced the `needsSave` block in `copyFragment()` to collect existing titles scoped to the same parent folder path (excluding the new copy itself) and resolve a unique title before saving.
- **Edited** `studio/src/editor-panel.js` — added `this.titleClone = this.fragment.title` in `showClone()` so the dialog pre-populates with the current title.
- **Edited** `studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js` — same `titleClone` initialization in `showClone()`.

**git diff --stat:** 3 files changed, 15 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-) (plus 2 new files created)
